page.overview:
Who is Corrin Clay?

is a firbolg living at the Blooming Grove. She is aunt to Caduceus Clay, sister to Constance Clay, and the eldest of the Clay family at the Grove. Like the others in her family, she left the Grove to find a way to protect it from the advancing corruption of the surrounding Savalirwood. She traveled alongside her sister Constance, and the pair were petrified at the Whitedawn Lagoon, where they remained until restored in 836 PD by Caduceus. She returned to the Grove with the rest of her family.

As an NPC, she is played by Matthew Mercer.

She has fading pink hair and pink skin. She is the eldest of the Clay family living at the Blooming Grove. After she was shattered as a petrified statue and ultimately restored, she became stiff and locked into a specific posture.

Corrin lived in the Blooming Grove in the Savalirwood of the Greying Wildlands with the rest of the Clay family. She, like all in the family, is a worshiper of Melora and spends her time administering burial by interment.
